description:
City life. The night. Cycling through town and finding new routes. This has always been the inspiration for Brompton Black Edition.

Styled for urban living; this range features sleek black componentry complementing a selection of different colour ways - either understated, or ready to make a statement with a popping colour. Black Edition is back.

No need for coordination. Black goes with everything. Understated yet still exuding plenty of style. The Brompton Black Edition M6L in Black features an M-type handlebar known as the ‘Classic Brompton handlebar’, a good all-rounder that provides a comfortable, upright riding position. It boasts a full range of 6 gears covering all riding needs, and it is equipped with mudguards, essential for cycling in any weather. This model also features a battery lighting kit, which includes a front Cateye Volt 400 USB rechargeable light and a rear battery lamp.

All Black Edition models feature the Brompton Front Carrier Block that works with all Brompton Luggage.
